description: Studio Code asks which of four looks to build for a neighborhood bakery (design-looks/), Wren & Barley's own among them.

content.text: Wren & Barley sounds lovely. Let's settle the look first: here are four directions, each drawn as a design board. Pick one and I'll show you layouts in it.

options.label: Quiet luxury editorial
options.description: Warm terracotta and white, one serif in spaced capitals, and the bread in the photos doing the talking.

options.label: Pastel soft
options.description: Light and airy, with blush and mint fields and a friendly rounded sans.

options.label: Mid-century retro
options.description: A bright diner-sign bakery in mustard, teal and burnt orange.

options.label: Scandinavian
options.description: Calm and clean: pale birch, slate, and plenty of space around the bread.
